project.title: Gleebs Protocol: HoloTactics
project.approval_status: source-validated for HoloVerse 278 same-window Windows acceptance; standalone HoloTactics preserved

design.style: futuristic HoloVerse tactical board with dark glass corner panels, cyan borders, green/purple Gleebs identity accents, red hostile corruption accents, expanding simulation sectors, lightweight synth audio, and one-shot tactical ability drops
avoid: UI panels covering tactical pieces or important board space
overwriting Gleebs with a generic cute robot look
large difficulty spikes before interactive review confirms the ramp feels fair
loud or constant sounds that fight the tactical pacing
design.core_hook: Gleebs leads a squad across a five-sector expanding corrupted holographic route. Destroyed enemies can randomly drop procedural one-shot abilities while the world grows from 8x8 to 16x16 as sectors are sealed.
design.pass11_sfx_rule: Audio/SFX only. Preserve Pass 07 UI, Pass 08 actor style, Pass 09 journey loop, and Pass 10 gentle challenge ramp while adding lightweight feedback cues and a mute toggle.
design.pass13_ability_rule: Ability loot pass. Procedural abilities are one-time use, player-facing, capped to a small cache, and should stay fun without overwhelming board readability.
design.pass14_world_rule: Bigger-world pass. The route expands to five sectors with larger boards and more space while preserving approved UI safe areas, actor readability, ability loot, audio, and gentle challenge progression.
design.pass15_audio_path_rule: Audio compatibility hotfix. Normalize Panda3D loader paths so Windows installs do not pass raw D:\... strings to loadSfx/loadMusic.
design.pass16_holoverse_rule: Full-source HoloVerse compatibility only. Mount the actual HoloTactics simulation into the existing HoloVerse ShowBase/window, inherit host display/HUD/graphics/audio mix settings, preserve standalone launch, and use TAB/ESC as HoloVerse return/menu authority. No placeholder tactical scene.

audio.note: SFX are generated lightweight WAV assets. Pass 15 normalizes audio paths before Panda3D loading to prevent raw Windows path load failures.
audio.path_compatibility: Windows drive paths are normalized to Panda-style /d/... paths before loadSfx/loadMusic.
audio.pass16_host_mix: When HoloVerse-hosted, real HoloTactics SFX/music remain active but volumes are scaled by HoloVerse master/SFX/music settings; the generic HoloVerse native music bed is suppressed to prevent overlap.

player_units.gleebs: dark core body, toxic green visor/highlights, purple armor breaks, paired cyan/red orb accents, horn/signal silhouette
player_units.guard: heavy broad defensive silhouette with shield mass and cyan controlled-hologram trim
player_units.runner: slim agile skirmisher silhouette with violet/cyan phase streaks

enemy_units.anomaly: dark fragmented melee disruptor with green/purple corruption and red hostile coding
enemy_units.sentry: floating ranged eye-drone with red targeting core and angular fins

controls.start: Enter, Space, or Left Mouse from title screen
controls.continue_journey: N, C, Enter, or Left Mouse after sector clear
controls.holoverse_return: TAB returns to HoloVerse when linked natively; ESC opens the shared HoloVerse menu while mounted.

journey_pass10_preserved.challenge_note: Threat still rises gently, but Pass 14 mainly increases route size and journey length rather than creating a difficulty spike.

abilities.notes: Abilities are generated from controlled names/effects and consumed after successful use.
